notes.title: update for build 0.9.8
notes.notes:
🏁 CRRaceManager.cs - The Core Race System

Purpose: Persistent singleton that manages race progression across multiple scenes

Key Features:

• Singleton Pattern: Persists between scene loads using DontDestroyOnLoad

• Race Countdown System: 5-4-3-2-1-GO countdown with car control management

• Position Tracking: Tracks racer positions across multiple races for championship standings

• Save/Load System: JSON-based persistence for continuing races after game restart

• Car Control: Manages when cars can/cannot move during countdown and positioning

Critical Components:

Major Fixes We Implemented:

1. Immediate Car Disabling: Cars are disabled immediately on scene load to prevent movement before countdown

2. Enhanced Position Recovery: Multiple fallback strategies for loading positions when save data is corrupted

3. Force Save System: Positions are saved immediately after each race to ensure persistence

4. Better AI Car Handling: Fixed aiCar.CarController.canControl vs aiCar.canControl issues

---

🚗 CRCarInfo.cs - Individual Car Race Logic

Purpose: Handles individual car race tracking, waypoint navigation, and finish detection

Key Features:

• Race Manager Integration: Subscribes to countdown events and respects race start timing

• Waypoint Tracking: Only tracks laps/waypoints when race has actually started

• Finish Detection: Detects when player completes required laps and triggers race end

• GUI Display: Shows lap progress, position, and countdown information

• Save Integration: Auto-saves race data when player finishes

Countdown Integration We Added:

Race Synchronization:

📊 FirstSecThird.cs - Race Position Tracking

Purpose: Real-time position tracking during races using waypoint-based calculations

Key Features:

• Real-time Position Calculation: Uses waypoint progress and lap completion to determine positions

• Player vs AI Tracking: Differentiates between player and AI racers

• Lap Time Recording: Tracks individual lap times and best lap times

• Position Updates: Provides live position data during races

Integration Points:

• CRRaceManager reads final positions from FirstSecThird when race ends

• CRCarInfo uses FirstSecThird data for GUI position display

• Position Matching: Complex name matching system to sync between different naming conventions

---

🎮 MenuBallPlay.cs - Main Menu & Game Flow

Purpose: Handles main menu, game start options, and scene transitions

Key Features:

• Continue vs New Game: Detects saved progress and offers to continue or start fresh

• Loading Screens: Animated loading with progress bars and countdown

• CRRaceManager Integration: Properly calls StartNewGame() to clear save data

• Controller Support: Full controller navigation for menu and dialogs

Race Manager Integration We Fixed:

🔧 Key Issues We Solved:

1. Car Movement During Countdown

• Problem: Cars could move during countdown/positioning

• Solution: ImmediateDisableAllCars() on scene load, EnableAllCars() after countdown

2. Position Persistence Across Restarts

• Problem: Starting positions not preserved when restarting game

• Solution: Enhanced save/load with multiple validation layers and fallback recovery

3. Race Manager Synchronization

• Problem: Race manager data not properly synced between scenes

• Solution: SyncAllRacersFromFirstSecThird() to get exact finish order

4. AI Car Control Issues

• Problem: RCC_AICarController doesn't have direct canControl property

• Solution: Use aiCar.CarController.canControl to access underlying controller

5. Menu Integration

• Problem: Menu not properly integrating with race manager for new/continue games

• Solution: Proper StartNewGame() calls and save file detection

---

🏆 Race Flow Summary:

1. Game Start: MenuBallPlay detects saves, offers continue/new game options

2. Scene Load: CRRaceManager immediately disables all cars

3. Positioning: Cars positioned based on previous race finish order (if not first race)

4. Countdown: 5-4-3-2-1-GO countdown while cars remain disabled

5. Race Start: Cars enabled, race tracking begins in CRCarInfo

6. During Race: FirstSecThird tracks live positions, CRCarInfo monitors player progress

7. Race End: CRCarInfo detects finish, syncs all positions from FirstSecThird

8. Scene Transition: CRRaceManager saves progress and loads next scene

9. Next Race: Process repeats with positions from previous race determining starting grid

This system ensures:

• ✅ Cars never move until countdown completes

• ✅ Starting positions persist across game restarts

• ✅ Race results are properly saved and loaded

• ✅ Menu properly integrates with race progression

• ✅ Championship standings are maintained across all races

The system now provides a complete, persistent racing experience where players can continue their championship progress even after closing and reopening the game!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Key Changes Made:

New Features Added:

1.	Waypoint Timeout Detection: Tracks how long the AI has been trying to reach the current waypoint

2.	Off-Track Detection: If the AI doesn't reach a waypoint within 10 seconds and is far from it, it's considered off-track

3.	Smart Repositioning:

•	For stuck scenarios: repositions to current waypoint

•	For missed waypoint scenarios: repositions to next waypoint and updates progress counters

Enhanced Logic:

1.	Dual Monitoring: The script now monitors both movement (stuck detection) and waypoint progress (missed waypoint detection)

2.	Distance Tolerance: Uses waypoint radius × 2 as tolerance to avoid false positives when AI is just moving slowly

3.	Progress Tracking: Properly updates currentWaypointIndex, totalWaypointPassed, and lap counters when skipping waypoints

4.	Better Debugging: More detailed log messages to help track what's happening

Performance Considerations:

•	Both checks use separate intervals (0.5 seconds) to minimize performance impact

•	Only performs expensive distance calculations when necessary

•	Reuses existing waypoint data structures

This enhanced script will now handle both scenarios you described:

•	Stuck for 10 seconds: Repositions to current waypoint

•	Missing waypoint within 10 seconds: Repositions to next waypoint and updates progress

The AI cars should now be much more reliable at staying on track and continuing the race even when they encounter obstacles or navigation issues.
